Settings.ApiKeyDescription: Optional bearer token used when calling the server.
Settings.ValidateToFetchModels: Click Validate after saving the server settings to fetch available models.
Settings.StreamResponsesDescription: Render prompt-action output token-by-token as the server generates it (works with Ollama, LM Studio, vLLM, etc.), instead of waiting for the full reply.
Settings.CouldNotConnect: Could not connect to the server.
Settings.ProfilesDescription: Extra OpenAI-compatible endpoints. Each profile appears as its own transcription engine and LLM provider you can select in dictation and prompts. The default endpoint above is unaffected.
Settings.ProfileApiKeyDescription: Leave blank to keep the current key.
Settings.ProfileTranscriptionModelDescri: Optional default; any fetched model can be chosen per workflow.
Settings.ProfileLlmModelDescription: Optional default; prompts can use any fetched model.
Manifest.Name: OpenAI Compatible
Manifest.Description: Connect to any OpenAI-compatible server (Ollama, LM Studio, vLLM, etc.)
